title: AUSO: Action-Level Unified Skill Optimization from Internalization to Utilization
abstract: arXiv:2608.21292v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Skills play different roles as an agent's policy evolves: they should first provide learnable knowledge, then support capability formation, and finally be invoked only when they improve individual decisions. Existing methods rarely model this lifecycle. They either keep skills outside the model, fully internalize them, or select among internalization and utilization objectives through noisy task-level success rates. Such designs fragment training and assign uniform importance to actions within the same trajectory, even though skill guidance may help some decisions while distracting others. To solve these problems, we introduce AUSO (Action-level Unified Skill Optimization), which unifies skill learning and skill use through a progressive, action-aware optimization process. translated_title: AUSO：从内化到利用的动作级统一技能优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21292v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随着智能体策略的演化，技能扮演着不同的角色：它们首先应提供可学习的知识，然后支持能力形成，最后仅在能改善个体决策时被调用。现有方法很少模拟这一生命周期。它们要么将技能保留在模型外部，要么完全内化技能，或通过嘈杂的任务级成功率在内化和利用目标之间进行选择。这种设计割裂了训练过程，并对同一轨迹中的动作赋予统一的权重，尽管技能引导可能有助于某些决策，却干扰其他决策。为解决这些问题，我们引入了AUSO（动作级统一技能优化），它通过一个渐进的、动作感知的优化过程统一了技能学习和技能使用。在训练初期，AUSO联合学习教师指导和环境结果，使策略能够在不丢失基础知识的情况下获取基础技能。
tldr: AUSO提出了一种动作级的渐进统一优化方法，将技能的内化与利用阶段无缝衔接，并通过动作感知的权重分配克服了传统方法中训练割裂和动作重要性均匀化的问题。
en_tdlr: AUSO introduces an action-level progressive unified optimization method that seamlessly bridges skill internalization and utilization, overcoming training fragmentation and uniform action importance through action-aware weighting.
